result.topic_en: The page describes a function defined by inverting a ratio of solutions of a linear differential equation, invariant under the equation's monodromy group, compares it to Picard's functions, and then asks whether all finite groups of linear transformations are holoedrically isomorphic to groups of linear fractional substitutions in one variable.
